bunaphile-cafe.blurb: A Hindustan Park cafe on the ground floor of the writer Nabaneeta Dev Sen's house, which she called 'Bhalobasa'. Rated about 4.0 from over 1,000 reviews.

tips.expect: A literary, heritage-house cafe known for its wide variety of coffee.
tips.good: The setting inside a writer's home and the coffee list.
tips.watch: Seating is limited and it fills up on weekend evenings.
tips.tip: A short walk from the Hindustan Park pandal.

mud-the-retro-cafe.blurb: A retro-styled cafe and restaurant on Keyatala Lane, Golpark, rated about 4.4.

tips.expect: A themed cafe in the Hindustan Park cluster.
tips.tip: Near Hindustan Park, Bunaphile and Wise Owl.

wise-owl-the-coffee-shop.blurb: A Hindustan Park coffee shop on Purna Das Road with artsy decor and outdoor seating.

tips.expect: A relaxed coffee shop with an excellent breakfast menu and snacks through the day.
tips.watch: It is small and gets full in the evening.
tips.tip: Go early for breakfast before the Gariahat crowds.

tribe.blurb: Tribe Cafe at Gol Park, with a Goan-leaning menu and five seating sections, including a cosy room with plush turquoise sofas.

tips.expect: A relaxed multi-room cafe, suited to book clubs and small groups, with Goan dishes on the menu.
tips.good: Goan dishes, which are rare in Kolkata.
tips.tip: A calm break near the Gariahat pandals.

blue-mug-cafe.blurb: A well-liked Jodhpur Park hangout with cosy indoor and outdoor seating, popular with young people for its pocket-friendly prices and shakes.

tips.expect: A casual cafe. A meal for two is about ₹700 or less.
tips.good: The shakes and the low prices.
tips.watch: It is on the Jadavpur side of the city.
tips.tip: A cheap break after the Jadavpur pandals.

pinkk-sugars-patisserie-and-artisanal-ba.blurb: A patisserie and artisanal bakery at AD-37, Sector 1, Salt Lake, open about noon to 9:30 pm.

tips.expect: A dessert stop. About ₹1,200 for two.
tips.tip: A sweet break between Sector 1 pandals.

cafe-proof.blurb: A Salt Lake cafe with an Italian, North Indian and street food menu, about ₹800 for two.

tips.expect: A casual cafe with something for everyone.
tips.tip: Easy to slot into the Sector 1 blocks plan.

calcutta-64.blurb: A restaurant at BC 25, Sector 1, Salt Lake, about ₹950 for two.

tips.watch: Reported hours are about 11:30 am to 10:30 pm.
tips.tip: Handy beside the Salt Lake block pandals.
